scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Sports And Adventure
description:
The National Award for Senior Citizens known as Vayoshreshtha Samman was established by the Government of India in 2005. 

This initiative aims to recognize the contributions of senior citizens to society. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The awards are conferred annually on the International Day of Older Persons which is celebrated on October 1. 

The primary objective of the Vayoshreshtha Samman is to honor senior citizens who have excelled in various fields. 

This includes sports and adventure activities which are often overlooked in the context of senior citizens. 

The awards are intended to encourage active participation among older adults in sports and adventure. 

The scheme aims to promote a healthy lifestyle among senior citizens. 

It also seeks to enhance their social status and encourage their involvement in community activities. 

The awards are presented in various categories including sports and adventure. 

Each awardee receives a cash prize along with a certificate of appreciation. 

The cash prize for the Vayoshreshtha Samman is INR 1 lakh. 

The award also includes a citation and a shawl. 

The eligibility criteria for the awards include being a citizen of India. 

Applicants must be aged 60 years or above. 

There are no specific income criteria for eligibility. 

Nominees must have made significant contributions to sports or adventure activities. 

The contributions can be in the form of achievements in competitions or promoting sports among senior citizens. 

The application process requires interested individuals or organizations to submit nominations. 

Nominations can be submitted online through the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The nomination form must be filled out completely with all required details. 

Documents required for the nomination include proof of age. 

This can be in the form of a birth certificate or any government-issued ID. 

Additionally, evidence of achievements in sports or adventure activities must be provided. 

This could include certificates, photographs, or media articles highlighting the nominee's contributions. 

The deadline for submitting nominations is typically set a few months prior to the award ceremony. 

For example, nominations for the 2023 awards were accepted until July 31, 2023. 

The selection process involves a committee that reviews all nominations. 

The committee is composed of experts in the field of sports and social welfare. 

They evaluate the contributions of each nominee based on predefined criteria. 

Winners are announced on October 1 during the International Day of Older Persons celebrations. 

The awards ceremony is a significant event that garners media attention. 

It aims to inspire other senior citizens to engage in sports and adventure activities. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman also serves to raise awareness about the capabilities of older adults. 

It highlights the importance of their participation in various sectors of society. 

In recent years the scheme has seen an increase in participation. 

This reflects a growing recognition of the potential of senior citizens in sports. 

The Government of India has also initiated various programs to promote sports among older adults. 

These initiatives include workshops and training sessions tailored for senior citizens. 

The aim is to provide them with the necessary skills and knowledge to participate in sports. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes for senior citizens. 

This framework includes pension schemes health care initiatives and social security measures. 

The Government of India allocates a specific budget for the Vayoshreshtha Samman each year. 

In the financial year 2022-2023 the budget allocation for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment was INR 1,000 crores. 

A portion of this budget is dedicated to the Vayoshreshtha Samman. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the public and senior citizen organizations. 

It is seen as a step towards empowering older adults and recognizing their contributions. 

The awards not only honor individual achievements but also promote a culture of respect for the elderly. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman encourages senior citizens to remain active and engaged. 

It fosters a sense of community and belonging among older adults. 

The scheme has also led to increased participation of senior citizens in various sports events. 

This includes marathons yoga competitions and adventure sports. 

The Government of India continues to promote the importance of sports for health and well-being. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a testament to the belief that age should not be a barrier to participation in sports. 

It showcases the talents and capabilities of senior citizens. 

The scheme aims to inspire younger generations to respect and support their elders. 

In conclusion the Vayoshreshtha Samman is a significant initiative. 

It recognizes the achievements of senior citizens in sports and adventure. 

The scheme promotes active aging and encourages a healthy lifestyle among older adults. 

The awards serve as a motivation for senior citizens to pursue their passions. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a vital part of India's commitment to the welfare of its elderly population. 

It reflects the government's dedication to improving the quality of life for senior citizens. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of the aging population in India. 

It stands as a beacon of hope and recognition for the contributions of older adults. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is not just an award but a celebration of life and vitality in old age.
